text:
sasha: Quick sync — Q3 devex roadmap triage. Need to pick top 3 initiatives for SDKs/docs/quickstarts. Short thread for votes and constraints.

mike: +1. My list: (1) mobile SDK GA spike & tutorial, (2) standardized quickstart repo with CI, (3) embeddings sample app with offline recipe.

anya: customer ask from ACME — wants an on-prem quickstart for embeddings and docs showing KMS + HSM flow. High priority for sales.

kevin: From infra: mobile SDK requires native CI infra. ETA 6w if prioritized. Also quantization presets depend on runtime work.

dev-bot: Issue created: DEVEX-4321 "mobile-sdk-spike" — assigned to mike.

sasha: Can we quantify impact? estimated OKR points: mobile 8, quickstart repo 5, embeddings offline 7.

mike: Suggest we choose: 1) embeddings offline quickstart (customer & demo), 2) quickstart repo + CI, 3) docs: KMS/HSM cookbook. Mobile SDK becomes Q4.

anya: +1 to that ordering. Also propose acceptance criteria for embeddings quickstart: reproducible demo app, sample dataset, perf notes, and security doc. If we hit those, mark done.

kevin: Operational criteria: must support Dedicated and Private flows, include sample config for VPC connector, and automated tests in CI.

sasha: Agree. Add launch criteria: 1) sample app + test suite passing in CI, 2) 1 customer pilot signed (or internal dogfood), 3) docs and short tutorial video.

mike: Who's owning the video? devex & marketing joint — suggest clara for script, mike for recording.

clara: happy to do script. timeline? 2 weeks after PR merge.

anya: I'll reach out to ACME for pilot commitment — target EOW.

sasha: Action items: - mike: create skeleton repo + PR by Wed - kevin: CI infra estimate by Thu - anya: customer outreach + pilot by EOW - clara: script draft by next Tue

mike: will open RFC with brief scope this afternoon. Attaching quick checklist:

```
- reproducible sample
- CI tests (unit + e2e)
- Dedicated/Private config
- security checklist
- tutorial video
```

kevin: Noted. Also need perf baseline doc: tokens/sec, memory.

sasha: ok, let's reconvene Fri 10am to finalize priority and OKR mapping. :calendar:

anya: sounds good :thumbsup:

mike: thanks all
